text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-616-Black Spiral Forged Black Iron Offset Pull

From the "Forged Iron Collection" by First Impressions, this spiral black iron offset pull will compliment any decor. Made from solid heavy black iron it will last a lifetime.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-616-Black Door Pull

  • Pull Length: 14-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Overall Width with bracket 3"
  • Offset Center to Center 1-7/8"
  • Pull Material: Solid Forged Iron
  • Black Iron Finish

Packaged standard with surface mounting (screws to the door face with #8 screws).

*Sold individually.
